NAME:
   juicefs format - Format a volume

USAGE:
   juicefs format [command options] META-URL NAME

CATEGORY:
   ADMIN

DESCRIPTION:
   
   Create a new JuiceFS volume. Here META-URL is used to set up the metadata engine (Redis, TiKV, MySQL, etc.),
   and NAME is the prefix of all objects in data storage.

   DEPRECATED: It was also used to change configuration of an existing volume, but now this function is
   deprecated, instead please use the "config" command.

   Examples:
   # Create a simple test volume (data will be stored in a local directory)
   $ juicefs format sqlite3://myjfs.db myjfs

   # Create a volume with Redis and S3
   $ juicefs format redis://localhost myjfs --storage s3 --bucket https://mybucket.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com

   # Create a volume with password protected MySQL
   $ juicefs format mysql://jfs:mypassword@(127.0.0.1:3306)/juicefs myjfs
   # A safer alternative
   $ META_PASSWORD=mypassword juicefs format mysql://jfs:@(127.0.0.1:3306)/juicefs myjfs

   # Create a volume with "quota" enabled
   $ juicefs format sqlite3://myjfs.db myjfs --inodes 1000000 --capacity 102400

   # Create a volume with "trash" disabled
   $ juicefs format sqlite3://myjfs.db myjfs --trash-days 0

   Details: https://juicefs.com/docs/community/quick_start_guide

OPTIONS:
   --force      overwrite existing format (default: false)
   --no-update  don't update existing volume (default: false)

   DATA STORAGE

   --storage value        object storage type (e.g. s3, gs, oss, cos) (default: "file")
   --bucket value         the bucket URL of object storage to store data (default: "/var/jfs")
   --access-key value     access key for object storage (env ACCESS_KEY)
   --secret-key value     secret key for object storage (env SECRET_KEY)
   --session-token value  session token for object storage
   --storage-class value  the default storage class
   --tag value            custom tag when uploading object storage (e.g. --tag key=value)

   DATA FORMAT

   --block-size value       size of block in KiB (default: "4M")
   --compress value         compression algorithm (lz4, zstd, none) (default: "none")
   --encrypt-rsa-key value  a path to RSA private key (PEM)
   --encrypt-algo value     encrypt algorithm (aes256gcm-rsa, chacha20-rsa) (default: "aes256gcm-rsa")
   --hash-prefix            add a hash prefix to name of objects (default: false)
   --shards value           store the blocks into N buckets by hash of key (default: 0)

   MANAGEMENT

   --capacity value              hard quota of the volume limiting its usage of space in GiB
   --inodes value                hard quota of the volume limiting its number of inodes (default: 0)
   --trash-days value            number of days after which removed files will be permanently deleted (default: 1)
   --enable-acl                  enable POSIX ACL (this flag is irreversible once enabled) (default: false)
   --ranger-rest-url value       URL of the RangerAdmin
   --ranger-service value        Name of the Ranger service used For JuiceFS
   --kerberos-config-file value  Path to Kerberos configuration file

NAME:
   juicefs mount - Mount a volume

USAGE:
   juicefs mount [command options] META-URL MOUNTPOINT

CATEGORY:
   SERVICE

DESCRIPTION:
   
   Mount the target volume at the mount point.

   Examples:
   # Mount in foreground
   $ juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs

   # Mount in background with password protected Redis
   $ juicefs mount redis://:mypassword@localhost /mnt/jfs -d
   # A safer alternative
   $ META_PASSWORD=mypassword juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs -d

   # Mount with a sub-directory as root
   $ juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs --subdir /dir/in/jfs

   # Enable "writeback" mode, which improves performance at the risk of losing objects
   $ juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs -d --writeback

   # Enable "read-only" mode
   $ juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs -d --read-only

   # Disable metadata backup
   $ juicefs mount redis://localhost /mnt/jfs --backup-meta 0

OPTIONS:
   -d, --background                run in background (default: false)
   --no-syslog                     disable syslog (default: false)
   --log value                     path of log file when running in background (default: "/var/log/juicefs.log")
   --force                         force to mount even if the mount point is already mounted by the same filesystem (default: false)
   --hide-internal                 hide all internal files (.accesslog, .stats, etc.) (default: false)
   --update-fstab                  add / update entry in /etc/fstab, will create a symlink from /sbin/mount.juicefs to JuiceFS executable if not existing (default: false)
   --disable-transparent-hugepage  disable transparent huge page to avoid latency spikes caused by kernel's memory compaction (default: false)

   FUSE

   --enable-xattr       enable extended attributes (xattr) (default: false)
   --enable-cap         enable security.capability xattr (default: false)
   --enable-selinux     enable security.selinux xattr (default: false)
   --enable-ioctl       enable ioctl (support GETFLAGS/SETFLAGS only) (default: false)
   --root-squash value  mapping local root user (uid = 0) to another one specified as <uid>:<gid>
   --all-squash value   mapping all users to another one specified as <uid>:<gid>
   --prefix-internal    add '.jfs' prefix to all internal files (default: false)
   --max-fuse-io value  maximum size for fuse request (default: "128K")
   --umask value        umask for new files and directories in octal (overwrite the one from app)
   -o value             other FUSE options

   META

   --subdir value              mount a sub-directory as root
   --backup-meta value         interval to automatically backup metadata in the object storage (0 means disable backup) (default: "1h")
   --backup-skip-trash         skip files in trash when backup metadata (default: false)
   --heartbeat value           interval to send heartbeat; it's recommended that all clients use the same heartbeat value (default: "12s")
   --read-only                 allow lookup/read operations only (default: false)
   --no-bgjob                  disable background jobs (clean-up, backup, etc.) (default: false)
   --atime-mode value          when to update atime, supported mode includes: noatime, relatime, strictatime (default: "noatime")
   --skip-dir-nlink value      number of retries after which the update of directory nlink will be skipped (used for tkv only, 0 means never) (default: 20)
   --skip-dir-mtime value      skip updating attribute of a directory if the mtime difference is smaller than this value (default: "100ms")
   --sort-dir                  sort entries within a directory by name (default: false)
   --fast-statfs               Use local counters for statfs instead of querying metadata service (default: false)
   --network-interfaces value  comma-separated list of network interfaces to use for IP discovery (e.g. eth0,en0), empty means all

   META CACHE

   --attr-cache value            attributes cache timeout (default: "1.0s")
   --entry-cache value           file entry cache timeout (default: "1.0s")
   --dir-entry-cache value       dir entry cache timeout (default: "1.0s")
   --negative-entry-cache value  cache timeout for negative entry lookups
   --readdir-cache               enable kernel caching of readdir entries, with timeout controlled by attr-cache flag (require linux kernel 4.20+) (default: false)
   --open-cache value            The cache time to reuse open file without checking update (0 means disable this feature) (default: "0s")
   --open-cache-limit value      max number of open files to cache (soft limit, 0 means unlimited) (default: 10000)

   DATA STORAGE

   --storage value          customized storage type (e.g. s3, gs, oss, cos) to access object store
   --bucket value           customized endpoint to access object store
   --storage-class value    the storage class for data written by current client
   --tag value              custom tag when uploading object storage (e.g. --tag key=value)
   --get-timeout value      the timeout to download an object (default: "60s")
   --put-timeout value      the timeout to upload an object (default: "60s")
   --io-retries value       number of retries after network failure (default: 10)
   --max-uploads value      number of connections to upload (default: 20)
   --max-downloads value    number of connections to download (default: 200)
   --max-stage-write value  number of threads allowed to write staged files, other requests will be uploaded directly (this option is only effective when 'writeback' mode is enabled) (default: 1000)
   --max-deletes value      number of threads to delete objects (default: 10)
   --upload-limit value     bandwidth limit for upload in Mbps
   --download-limit value   bandwidth limit for download in Mbps
   --check-storage          test storage before mounting to expose access issues early (default: false)

   DATA CACHE

   --buffer-size value               total read/write buffering in MiB (default: "300M")
   --max-readahead value             max buffering for read ahead in MiB per read session
   --prefetch value                  prefetch N blocks in parallel (default: 1)
   --writeback                       upload blocks in background (default: false)
   --writeback-threshold-size value  blocks smaller than this size will be staged, 0 means all staged. (default: "0")
   --upload-delay value              delayed duration for uploading blocks (default: "0s")
   --upload-hours value              (start-end) hour of a day between which the delayed blocks can be uploaded
   --cache-dir value                 directory paths of local cache, use colon to separate multiple paths (default: "/var/jfsCache")
   --cache-mode value                file permissions for cached blocks (default: "0600")
   --cache-size value                size of cached object for read in MiB (default: "100G")
   --cache-items free‑space‑ratio    max number of cached items (0 will be automatically calculated based on the free‑space‑ratio.) (default: 0)
   --free-space-ratio value          min free space (ratio) (default: 0.1)
   --cache-partial-only              cache only random/small read (default: false)
   --cache-large-write               cache full blocks after uploading (default: false)
   --verify-cache-checksum value     checksum level (none, full, shrink, extend) (default: "extend")
   --cache-eviction value            cache eviction policy [none, 2-random, lru] (default: "2-random")
   --cache-scan-interval value       interval to scan cache-dir to rebuild in-memory index (default: "1h")
   --cache-expire value              cached blocks not accessed for longer than this option will be automatically evicted (0 means never) (default: "0s")

   METRICS

   --metrics value        address to export metrics (default: "127.0.0.1:9567")
   --custom-labels value  custom labels for metrics
   --consul value         consul address to register (default: "127.0.0.1:8500")
   --no-usage-report      do not send usage report (default: false)

[Unit]
Description=BrewFS Single Node Mount
Documentation=https://github.com/brewfs/brewfs
After=network-online.target brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service
Wants=network-online.target brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service
Requires=brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service

[Service]
Type=simple
EnvironmentFile=/data/brewfs-default/brewfs
ExecStartPre=/data/brewfs-libexec/init-rustfs-bucket
ExecStart=/data/bin/brewfs mount --config /data/brewfs-config/mount.yaml
ExecStop=-/bin/sh -c 'if command -v fusermount3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then fusermount3 -u /mnt/brewfs; else umount /mnt/brewfs; fi'
WorkingDirectory=/data/brewfs-state
User=root
Group=root
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
TasksMax=infinity
NoNewPrivileges=true
StandardOutput=append:/data/brewfs-logs/brewfs.log
StandardError=append:/data/brewfs-logs/brewfs-err.log

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

After=network-online.target brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service
Wants=network-online.target brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service
Requires=brewfs-redis.service brewfs-rustfs.service

[Service]
Type=simple
EnvironmentFile=/data/brewfs-default/brewfs
ExecStartPre=/data/brewfs-libexec/init-rustfs-bucket
ExecStart=/data/bin/brewfs mount --config /data/brewfs-config/mount.yaml
ExecStop=-/bin/sh -c 'if command -v fusermount3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then fusermount3 -u /mnt/brewfs; else umount /mnt/brewfs; fi'
WorkingDirectory=/data/brewfs-state
User=root
Group=root
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
TasksMax=infinity
NoNewPrivileges=true
StandardOutput=append:/data/brewfs-logs/brewfs.log
StandardError=append:/data/brewfs-logs/brewfs-err.log

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/brewfs-redis.service
[Unit]
Description=BrewFS Redis Metadata Server
Documentation=https://github.com/redis/redis
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
EnvironmentFile=/data/brewfs-default/brewfs-redis
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redis-server /data/brewfs-config/redis.conf
WorkingDirectory=/data/brewfs-state/redis
User=root
Group=root
Restart=always
RestartSec=3s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/data/brewfs-state/redis /data/brewfs-logs

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/brewfs-rustfs.service
[Unit]
Description=BrewFS RustFS Object Storage Server
Documentation=https://rustfs.com/docs/
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
EnvironmentFile=/data/brewfs-default/brewfs-rustfs
ExecStart=/data/bin/rustfs ${RUSTFS_VOLUMES}
WorkingDirectory=/data/brewfs-state/rustfs
User=root
Group=root
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
TasksMax=infinity
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/data/brewfs-state/rustfs /data/brewfs-logs
StandardOutput=append:/data/brewfs-logs/rustfs-stdout.log
StandardError=append:/data/brewfs-logs/rustfs-err.log

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
